task.title: Bound output buffering by bytes
task.problem: LineBuffer limits record count, so a small number of very long lines can still consume substantial memory.
task.proposal: Use a byte-aware buffer threshold and preserve streaming/backpressure behavior; document what rg itself buffers for long lines.
acceptance: Short/long-line workloads preserve JSON and text output.
Buffered memory has a documented bound except a single already-materialized match.
Closed-pipe and interruption tests still pass.
